test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Be on the breadline

options.text: Find a successful way of making money
Earn a lot of money very easily

solution: The correct answer is 'Be Very Poor'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate meaning of the idiom 'Be on breadline' is 'Be very poor'.(बहुत गरीब) • Be on breadline: the level of income at which someone is considered poor.(आय का वह स्तर जिस पर किसी को गरीब माना जाता है) • Example: Many people without jobs a kire living on the breadline. • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above the correct answer is option 4. Correct Sentence:__ Be very poor. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ Idiom Meaning Example play (merry) hell with sth to seriously damage or confuse something The power cuts played hell with our computers. play (sth) by ear to play a piece of music by remembering the notes He did not need sheet music. He could play the piece by ear. play a joke/trick on sb to confuse someone or cause a problem for them Fate played a cruel trick on him when he was injured in his first game. 2ec:T2543,
